title: Exactly one to-do after adding one
summary: After adding the to-do "b", the list shows exactly one row, and that row reads "b".
what_differs: The broken page renders an extra empty list item above "b", which appears as a blank row.
steps: Type "b" into the "New to-do" box and press Enter.

wordings.text: Verify the todo list shows exactly one todo, "b".
Verify the to-do list has exactly 1 item and that item's text is "b".
